name: Cosmic Hopper
author: Bernardo Wilchen de Oliveira
description: Help Zorp the alien hop across a highway of speeding spaceships and a stardust river to fill 4 landing pads, over 3 stages. Arrows to hop.

descriptions.en: Help Zorp the alien hop across a highway of speeding spaceships and a stardust river to fill 4 landing pads, over 3 stages. Arrows to hop.
descriptions.it: Aiuta l'alieno Zorp ad attraversare un'autostrada di astronavi e un fiume di polvere di stelle fino alle 4 piattaforme, in 3 livelli. Frecce per saltare.
